//LindwurmFang: Niche N4 (MASTER_PLAN section 2): the lindwurm's trophy. The Butcher of CardData/Item/hw_lindwurm_carcass.json drops one, and CardData/Blueprint/hw_bp_charm_dragon.json needs it, so the rarest fight pays in a ritual object and not in more meat (the 150 meat of HW-B6 is untouched). A plain CardType 0 with no actions, no durability and no tags: it is only carried to the charm's blueprint. The picture is the vanilla sprite Hook_Bone (PARTIAL: no card art was generated in the authoring session, the OpenArt tool was not reachable; the intended subject is one long curved off-white fang with a yellowed root). Weight and trading value are TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS.

CardDescription.DefaultText: A curved fang as long as a hand, drawn from the jaw of a lindwurm. It is good for nothing but the old rites: a carver can make a charm of it for the Dragon Spirit.
